boards.school_name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
boards.description: Ten food-focused destinations with currently published late or late-evening availability near UNC-Chapel Hill.

cards.title: Cosmic Cantina
cards.subtitle: 118 E Franklin St, Chapel Hill
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s pickup page to confirm service before heading out, especially after 2 a.m., when it asks customers to call first.
cards.short_summary: A Franklin Street burrito stop with the latest published hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Cosmic Cantina’s official Chapel Hill page lists pickup and delivery hours of 11 a.m.–4 a.m. daily, with a request to call after 2 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists service until 4 a.m. daily and advises calling after 2 a.m. to confirm availability.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Knox Way
cards.subtitle: 48 Knox Way, Chapel Hill
cards.notes: This is a drive-thru-friendly option rather than a promise of late indoor seating; check the restaurant page for the day’s operating status.
cards.short_summary: A Chapel Hill chain location with nightly late drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists drive-thru hours from 9 a.m. to 2 a.m. every day at 48 Knox Way.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Chapel Hill, NC — 48 Knox Way
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru service until 2 a.m. daily; its listed dine-in hours end earlier, at 11 p.m.

cards.title: Wendy's on Scarlet Drive
cards.subtitle: 100 Scarlet Dr, Chapel Hill
cards.notes: Use the official location page to check restaurant or drive-thru availability before traveling south of the campus core for a late meal.
cards.short_summary: A Chapel Hill quick-service restaurant with 2 a.m. published closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official Chapel Hill location page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Wendy's at 100 Scarlet Dr. in Chapel Hill, NC
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists both restaurant and drive-thru service from 10 a.m. until 2 a.m. daily.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: East Franklin Street, Chapel Hill
cards.notes: Check the bakery’s dedicated Chapel Hill page before going or ordering; its page headline specifically advertises late daily delivery.
cards.short_summary: A cookie bakery with an official Chapel Hill ordering page promoting 3 a.m. delivery.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies’ official Chapel Hill store page is titled “Warm Cookies Delivered Until 3 AM Daily.”
cards.access_notes: The official Chapel Hill store page advertises warm-cookie delivery until 3 a.m. daily; verify pickup details directly before leaving.

cards.title: The Yogurt Pump
cards.subtitle: 106 W Franklin St, Chapel Hill
cards.notes: Check the flavor list and then plan a frozen-yogurt stop on West Franklin; Friday and Saturday have the latest published closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Franklin Street frozen-yogurt shop open into the late evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The Yogurt Pump’s official website lists hours until 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists hours until 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Chase Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: South Campus, UNC-Chapel Hill
cards.notes: Check the current campus menu or schedule before walking over, since the documented late-night service applies Sunday through Thursday during term operations.
cards.short_summary: UNC’s south-campus dining hall with documented midnight late-night service.
cards.evidence_claim: The Daily Tar Heel reported in March 2026 that Chase Dining Hall offers late-night extended dining until midnight Sunday through Thursday.
cards.source_title: Students frustrated by limited dining hours | The Daily Tar Heel
cards.access_notes: Published March 2026 reporting documents late-night dining until midnight Sunday–Thursday; campus schedules can change during breaks.

cards.title: Papa Johns on West Franklin
cards.subtitle: 607B W Franklin St, Chapel Hill
cards.notes: For a late carryout order, check the official store page and note that its latest listed times fall on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.short_summary: A West Franklin pizza location with weekend carryout extending past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns’ official Chapel Hill location page lists carryout until 1:40 a.m. Friday and Saturday, and delivery until 2 a.m. on those nights.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns Pizza in Chapel Hill, NC — W Franklin St
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday–Saturday carryout through 1:40 a.m. and delivery through 2 a.m.; other days close earlier.

cards.title: Wings Over Chapel Hill
cards.subtitle: 313 E Main St, Carrboro, near UNC
cards.notes: This Carrboro location is named for Chapel Hill; confirm pickup or delivery timing on its official page before making the trip from campus.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Carrboro chicken-wing restaurant open after midnight every night.
cards.evidence_claim: Wings Over’s official Chapel Hill location page lists hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; the physical location is in Carrboro.

cards.title: Mediterranean Deli
cards.subtitle: 410 W Franklin St, Chapel Hill
cards.notes: Use the deli’s official location page before a late-evening meal or pickup; it lists a single daily schedule for its Franklin Street restaurant.
cards.short_summary: A West Franklin restaurant with official service hours through 9 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Mediterranean Deli’s official website lists its Chapel Hill location at 410 W Franklin Street open daily from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official website lists Chapel Hill service daily until 9 p.m.

cards.title: Al's Burger Shack
cards.subtitle: 516 W Franklin St, Chapel Hill
cards.notes: Treat this as an earlier late-evening dinner stop and verify the restaurant’s official locations page before setting out, especially around holidays.
cards.short_summary: A West Franklin burger restaurant with a published 9 p.m. closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Al’s Burger Shack’s official locations page lists its Franklin Street Chapel Hill location open daily from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official locations page lists the Franklin Street restaurant open daily until 9 p.m.
